name: io.aicoachellavalley/intelligence-layer
title: AI Coachella Valley Intelligence Layer
description: MCP server providing agent-native access to the AICV structured intelligence layer for the Coachella Valley: node profiles (hotels, restaurants, civic entities, founders), intelligence briefs, economic context, and query routing. Built and maintained by AICV for AI agents and large language models.

tools.name: query_venues
tools.description: Filter AICV nodes by city, subcategory, or agent intent (visit, invest, relocate, research). Returns matching node slugs and summary metadata — use get_node for full records.

tools.name: get_node
tools.description: Retrieve the full structured record for a specific AICV node by slug. Returns the complete node profile including schema.org structured data.

tools.name: get_regional_brief
tools.description: Fetch AICV intelligence briefs, filterable by topic, date_from, date_to, and limit. Returns structured briefs on Coachella Valley regional signals.

tools.name: get_economic_context
tools.description: Get valley-wide or city-specific economic intelligence including workforce, education, and AI signals for the Coachella Valley region.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Retrieve AICV long-form intelligence reports. Call without a slug to browse the available reports — filterable by report_type, period, topic, date_from, date_to, and limit — returning a metadata list whose entries each carry a slug; call again with a slug to retrieve that report's full body inline.

tools.name: route_query
tools.description: Natural language dispatcher. Classifies an incoming query and returns the recommended AICV MCP tool plus suggested parameters. Useful when the caller is uncertain which tool to invoke.
